author: Kurt Sanders
releaseNotes:
Version 2.3.0
• REQUIRES HPM v1.9.11 or higher for HPM install or update.
1. Added Preset High/Low Temperature preferences (presetTempHigh, presetTempLow) and stateful 'Spa Preset Temp (High/Low)' child switch that toggles setTemp between High (ON) and Low (OFF) and stays synced with live spa setpoint updates.
2. Fast-close TCP polling (~0.5s): closes socket immediately after receiving a fresh Panel Status Update (0x13) during routine refresh.
3. Real-time Generic Component Switch sync for Alexa, Google Home, and Dashboards (with state-aware Pump1-6 and Light1-2 control).
4. Added getFilterSchedule() command and automatic filter cycle polling after configure().
5. Added optional autoSyncClock preference with configurable drift threshold.
6. Fixed Celsius setpoint validation & 0.5°C protocol encoding, signed-byte (& 0xFF) parsing, Pump3/4/6 config bitmasks, setHeatMode(), and Lights/Pumps/Mister events.
7. Added event deduplication, compact spaPanelHTML (<1024 bytes), and App UI enhancements (IPv4 validation, TCP port, polling interval, and momentary switch toggle).
